closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin C, zest and segments are both useful, and brings a clean fruit identity, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein quality, and low omega 3. It is good for low-calorie flavour swaps, immune support, and low-calorie volume because the pros make it useful for adding flavour without much nutrition load, vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
